name: Prompt Tracer
description: Capture full-chain LLM prompt traces (system prompt, LLM input, wire body, tool calls, assistant reply) to an XML file with a self-contained HTML viewer.

enabled.label: Enable Prompt Tracer
enabled.help: When enabled, the plugin listens for /trace_start and /trace_end commands to capture per-session traces.

tracesDir.label: Traces Directory
tracesDir.help: Directory where XML traces and viewer HTML files are written. Supports ~ expansion.

maxBytesPerPrompt.label: Max Bytes Per Prompt
maxBytesPerPrompt.help: Maximum bytes retained per prompt/wire-body phase. Larger payloads are replaced with a digest and truncation marker.

captureWireBody.label: Capture Wire Body
captureWireBody.help: Wrap provider stream functions to capture the final HTTP body sent to the model. Requires the provider to expose wrapStreamFn.

captureImages.label: Capture Images
captureImages.help: Record image base64 data as-is. Disable to omit images from the trace for smaller files.

autoStartChannels.label: Auto-Start Channels
autoStartChannels.help: List of channel ids that start capturing automatically without /trace_start.

viewer.theme.label: Viewer Theme
viewer.theme.help: Default theme used by the HTML viewer.

viewer.inlineXml.label: Inline XML in Viewer
viewer.inlineXml.help: Embed the XML inside the viewer HTML so it opens via file:// without fetch.
